archimate:ValueStream.name: 8. Supply chain security
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
The service provider should ensure that its supply chain meets the same security standards that the organisation sets for itself. This includes where a third party has access to customer data or the service, and where the provider has dependencies on a third party such as when procuring hardware and software.
https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/cloud/the-cloud-security-principles/principle-8-supply-chain-security
